title: Mogitate SegaSaturn: Special Movie
native_title: モギタテセガサターン スペシャル・ムービー
overview: A special movie disc packaged with the third issue of Mogitate Sega Saturn, the members-only information disc sent to Sega Partners, Sega's Saturn fan club. It holds video features on two Saturn games: the survival horror title Deep Fear and the turn-based strategy game Shadows of the Tusk.
